annotations.title: Fertility procedure and add-on prices: what providers post

description: What US providers post on their own pages as the self-pay price of a fertility procedure, test or add-on, each quoted with its page and what the price covers, listed by state and never ranked: hysteroscopy, HSG, laparoscopy, myomectomy, varicocele repair, surgical sperm retrieval (micro-TESE and others), the ERA test, ovarian PRP, IVF with gender selection, genetic carrier screening and fertility acupuncture, with the guideline or trial evidence on each, quoted.

procedure.description: Which procedure: hysteroscopy, hsg, laparoscopy, myomectomy, varicocele-repair, sperm-retrieval, era-test, ovarian-prp, gender-selection, carrier-screening or acupuncture.
